instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: IDS/IPS in encrypted environments, integration and reliability
topic_ar: IDS/IPS في البيئات المشفّرة والتكامل والموثوقية

questions.question: Which three solutions does the chapter offer for inspecting encrypted traffic?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاثة حلول يقدّمها الفصل لفحص الترافيك المشفّر؟
options: Signature compression, log rotation and sampling.
TLS termination, metadata analysis and traffic analytics.
Key escrow, password recovery and forced downgrade.
Packet replay, header stripping and port mirroring.
options_ar: ضغط التوقيعات وتدوير السجلات وأخذ العيّنات.
إنهاء TLS وتحليل الميتاداتا وتحليلات الترافيك.
إيداع المفاتيح واستعادة كلمات المرور والتخفيض القسري.
إعادة إرسال الحزم ونزع الترويسات ونسخ المنافذ.
options_en: Signature compression, log rotation and sampling.
TLS termination, metadata analysis and traffic analytics.
Key escrow, password recovery and forced downgrade.
Packet replay, header stripping and port mirroring.
questions.explanation: The three routes are to decrypt at a termination point, to analyse handshake metadata, or to model traffic statistics with machine learning.
questions.explanation_ar: الطرق الثلاث هي فكّ التشفير عند نقطة إنهاء، أو تحليل ميتاداتا المصافحة، أو نمذجة إحصاءات الترافيك بتعلّم الآلة.

questions.question: What is the cost of using TLS termination to inspect encrypted traffic?
questions.question_ar: شنو ثمن استخدام إنهاء TLS لفحص الترافيك المشفّر؟
options: The traffic can no longer be re-encrypted afterwards.
The clients must disable certificate validation.
The server must publish its private key publicly.
The termination point becomes a high-value target.
options_ar: الترافيك ما يمكن إعادة تشفيره بعدها.
العملاء لازم يعطّلون التحقّق من الشهادات.
السيرفر لازم ينشر مفتاحه الخاص علناً.
نقطة الإنهاء تصير هدفاً عالي القيمة.
options_en: The traffic can no longer be re-encrypted afterwards.
The clients must disable certificate validation.
The server must publish its private key publicly.
The termination point becomes a high-value target.
questions.explanation: Decrypting in the middle means the middle holds the plaintext and the keys, which concentrates risk exactly where the inspection happens.
questions.explanation_ar: فكّ التشفير بالوسط يعني إن الوسط يحمل النص الصريح والمفاتيح، وهذا يجمّع الخطر بالضبط وين يصير الفحص.

questions.question: What does metadata analysis inspect instead of the payload?
questions.question_ar: شنو يحلّل تحليل الميتاداتا بدل الحمولة؟
options: Handshake fingerprints such as JA3.
The plaintext of the application messages.
The private keys stored on the server.
The certificate revocation lists.
options_en: Handshake fingerprints such as JA3.
The plaintext of the application messages.
The private keys stored on the server.
The certificate revocation lists.
questions.explanation: The handshake itself is visible even when the payload is not, so its fingerprint can identify a client or a tool without decrypting anything.
questions.explanation_ar: المصافحة نفسها مرئية حتى لو الحمولة مو مرئية، فبصمتها تقدر تعرّف عميلاً أو أداة بلا فكّ أي تشفير.

questions.question: What does encrypted traffic analytics rely on?
questions.question_ar: على شنو يعتمد تحليل الترافيك المشفّر؟
options: A complete copy of every decrypted payload.
Certificate pinning at the network edge.
Machine-learning models over traffic statistics.
Brute-forcing the session keys in real time.
options_ar: نسخة كاملة من كل حمولة مفكوكة.
موديلات تعلّم آلي على إحصاءات الترافيك.
كسر مفاتيح الجلسة بالقوة الغاشمة بالزمن الحقيقي.
options_en: A complete copy of every decrypted payload.
Certificate pinning at the network edge.
Machine-learning models over traffic statistics.
Brute-forcing the session keys in real time.
questions.explanation: It learns what flows look like rather than what they contain, which is why it works without decryption.
questions.explanation_ar: يتعلّم شكل التدفقات مو محتواها، ولهذا يشتغل بلا فكّ تشفير.

questions.question: How is the probability density of a flow modelled in that section?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُنمذَج كثافة احتمال التدفق بذلك القسم؟
options: A uniform distribution over the feature space.
A weighted sum of Gaussian components.
A single Gaussian fitted to the whole traffic.
The product of every feature's marginal.
options_ar: توزيع Gaussian واحد ملائم لكل الترافيك.
حاصل ضرب التوزيع الهامشي لكل سمة.
options_en: A uniform distribution over the feature space.
A weighted sum of Gaussian components.
A single Gaussian fitted to the whole traffic.
The product of every feature's marginal.
questions.explanation: A mixture allows one model to represent several normal modes of behaviour instead of assuming a single cluster.
questions.explanation_ar: الخليط يسمح لنموذج واحد يمثّل عدة أنماط طبيعية للسلوك بدل ما يفترض عنقوداً واحداً.

questions.question: What does a flow probability below the threshold indicate?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعني احتمال تدفق أقل من العتبة؟
options: That the flow is definitely a known attack.
That the model has not been trained yet.
That the threshold was configured backwards.
That the flow is anomalous relative to the model.
options_en: That the flow is definitely a known attack.
That the model has not been trained yet.
That the threshold was configured backwards.
That the flow is anomalous relative to the model.
questions.explanation: Low likelihood means the flow does not resemble the learned normal modes, which is suspicion and not proof.
questions.explanation_ar: الاحتمال المنخفض يعني إن التدفق ما يشبه الأنماط الطبيعية المتعلَّمة، وهذا شك مو دليل.

questions.question: Which features does the model use for encrypted traffic?
questions.question_ar: أي سمات يستخدمها النموذج للترافيك المشفّر؟
options: Packet size, timing and direction.
Payload keywords and regular expressions.
Usernames and password hashes.
Certificate subject and issuer names.
options_en: Packet size, timing and direction.
Payload keywords and regular expressions.
Usernames and password hashes.
Certificate subject and issuer names.
questions.explanation: Those three survive encryption because they describe the shape of the conversation rather than its content.
questions.explanation_ar: هذي الثلاثة تنجو من التشفير لأنها تصف شكل المحادثة مو محتواها.

questions.question: What did Suricata add that Snort did not originally offer?
questions.question_ar: شنو أضافت Suricata وما كان Snort يقدّمه أصلاً؟
options: The first anomaly-based detection engine.
Hardware acceleration on the network card.
Multithreaded performance for high-throughput networks.
A proprietary signature format with no sharing.
options_ar: أول محرّك كشف قائم على الشذوذ.
أداء متعدّد الخيوط للشبكات عالية الإنتاجية.
options_en: The first anomaly-based detection engine.
Hardware acceleration on the network card.
Multithreaded performance for high-throughput networks.
A proprietary signature format with no sharing.
questions.explanation: Snort became the open-source standard, and Suricata addressed the throughput ceiling with multithreading.
questions.explanation_ar: Snort صار المعيار مفتوح المصدر، و Suricata عالجت سقف الإنتاجية بالخيوط المتعدّدة.

questions.question: Why did Heartbleed illustrate a fundamental limit of IDS visibility?
questions.question_ar: ليش Heartbleed وضّحت حدّاً جوهرياً لرؤية الـ IDS؟
options: The attack used only ICMP packets to exfiltrate.
The leak happened inside an encrypted channel.
The bug was too new for any signature database.
The server had no IDS deployed at that time.
options_ar: الهجوم استخدم حزم ICMP فقط للتسريب.
الثغرة كانت أحدث من أي قاعدة توقيعات.
السيرفر ما كان عليه IDS وقتها.
options_en: The attack used only ICMP packets to exfiltrate.
The leak happened inside an encrypted channel.
The bug was too new for any signature database.
The server had no IDS deployed at that time.
questions.explanation: The vulnerability lived in the encrypted handshake path itself, so a sensor watching ciphertext had nothing to match against.
questions.explanation_ar: الثغرة كانت بمسار المصافحة المشفّر نفسه، فالمستشعر اللي يشوف نصاً مشفّراً ما عنده شي يطابقه.

questions.question: How did Stuxnet avoid detection?
questions.question_ar: كيف تجنّب Stuxnet الكشف؟
options: It encrypted every packet with a one-time pad.
It disabled the network interface of each host.
It ran only outside the monitored network.
Rootkits manipulated the process-control logs themselves.
options_ar: شفّرت كل حزمة بمفتاح لمرة واحدة.
روتكِتات تلاعبت بسجلات أنظمة التحكّم نفسها.
options_en: It encrypted every packet with a one-time pad.
It disabled the network interface of each host.
It ran only outside the monitored network.
Rootkits manipulated the process-control logs themselves.
questions.explanation: It attacked the evidence rather than the detector, which is why sophisticated adversaries are said to target IDS blind spots.
questions.explanation_ar: هاجم الدليل مو الكاشف، ولهذا يُقال إن الخصوم المتقدّمين يستهدفون النقاط العمياء للـ IDS.

questions.question: What single theme links the three case studies?
questions.question_ar: شنو الثيمة الواحدة اللي تربط الحالات الثلاث؟
options: Sophisticated adversaries aim at what the sensor cannot see.
Open-source tools always outperform commercial ones.
Encryption is the only cause of detection failure.
Signature databases are always out of date.
options_ar: الخصوم المتقدّمون يستهدفون ما لا يراه المستشعر.
الأدوات مفتوحة المصدر دائماً تتفوّق على التجارية.
التشفير هو السبب الوحيد لفشل الكشف.
options_en: Sophisticated adversaries aim at what the sensor cannot see.
Open-source tools always outperform commercial ones.
Encryption is the only cause of detection failure.
Signature databases are always out of date.
questions.explanation: Snort and Suricata show detection became commodity, while Heartbleed and Stuxnet show the blind spots are where the real damage happens.
questions.explanation_ar: Snort و Suricata يبيّنان إن الكشف صار سلعة، و Heartbleed و Stuxnet يبيّنان إن النقاط العمياء هي وين يصير الضرر الحقيقي.

questions.question: What does a SIEM system do with IDS/IPS alerts?
questions.question_ar: شنو يسوي نظام SIEM بتنبيهات IDS/IPS؟
options: It re-encrypts the traffic for storage.
It replaces the signature database entirely.
It correlates events across multiple sources.
It automatically blocks the offending host.
options_en: It re-encrypts the traffic for storage.
It replaces the signature database entirely.
It correlates events across multiple sources.
It automatically blocks the offending host.
questions.explanation: Its value is correlation: a single alert is weak evidence, but several related events together justify an incident.
questions.explanation_ar: قيمته بالربط: تنبيه واحد دليل ضعيف، لكن عدة أحداث مترابطة تبرّر إعلان حادثة.

questions.question: What does a SOAR platform contribute?
questions.question_ar: شنو تساهم به منصّة SOAR؟
options: It signs the alerts cryptographically.
It automates the response actions.
It correlates the events into incidents.
It stores the raw packet captures.
options_en: It signs the alerts cryptographically.
It automates the response actions.
It correlates the events into incidents.
It stores the raw packet captures.
questions.explanation: SIEM decides that something is an incident, while SOAR carries out the playbook, such as opening a ticket or isolating a host.
questions.explanation_ar: SIEM يقرّر إن شيئاً حادثة، و SOAR ينفّذ الخطة، مثل فتح تذكرة أو عزل مضيف.

questions.question: How is the correlation score of evidence computed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُحسب نتيجة ربط الأدلة؟
options: A weighted product of the individual evidence items.
The maximum weight among all evidence items.
The count of evidence items divided by their weights.
A weighted sum of the individual evidence items.
options_ar: حاصل ضرب مرجّح لبنود الأدلة المنفردة.
أقصى وزن بين كل بنود الأدلة.
عدد بنود الأدلة مقسوماً على أوزانها.
options_en: A weighted product of the individual evidence items.
The maximum weight among all evidence items.
The count of evidence items divided by their weights.
A weighted sum of the individual evidence items.
questions.explanation: Each piece of evidence contributes in proportion to its weight, and the total is compared against a threshold.
questions.explanation_ar: كل بند دليل يساهم بنسبة وزنه، والمجموع يُقارن بعتبة.

questions.question: What traffic does a cloud-native IDS mainly monitor?
questions.question_ar: أي ترافيك يراقبه نظام كشف سحابي المنشأ أساساً؟
options: East-west traffic inside virtualised networks.
North-south traffic at the physical perimeter.
Only traffic that leaves the cloud provider.
Only traffic between two cloud providers.
options_ar: فقط الترافيك اللي يخرج من مزوّد السحابة.
options_en: East-west traffic inside virtualised networks.
North-south traffic at the physical perimeter.
Only traffic that leaves the cloud provider.
Only traffic between two cloud providers.
questions.explanation: In cloud fabrics most of the interesting traffic never crosses the old perimeter, so sensors move inside the virtual network.
questions.explanation_ar: ببيئات السحابة أغلب الترافيك المهم ما يعبر المحيط القديم أبداً، فالمستشعرات تنتقل داخل الشبكة الافتراضية.

questions.question: What distinguishes evasion from poisoning as adversarial ML attacks?
questions.question_ar: شنو يميّز التهرّب عن التسميم كهجمات على التعلّم الآلي؟
options: Evasion targets the sensor; poisoning targets the network.
Evasion is passive; poisoning requires physical access.
Evasion manipulates the input; poisoning corrupts the training data.
Evasion corrupts the training data; poisoning manipulates input.
options_ar: التهرّب يستهدف المستشعر، والتسميم يستهدف الشبكة.
التهرّب سلبي، والتسميم يشترط وصولاً فيزيائياً.
التهرّب يتلاعب بالمدخل، والتسميم يفسد بيانات التدريب.
التهرّب يفسد بيانات التدريب، والتسميم يتلاعب بالمدخل.
options_en: Evasion targets the sensor; poisoning targets the network.
Evasion is passive; poisoning requires physical access.
Evasion manipulates the input; poisoning corrupts the training data.
Evasion corrupts the training data; poisoning manipulates input.
questions.explanation: One is an attack at inference time on a single input, the other is an attack at training time on the model's entire worldview.
questions.explanation_ar: واحد هجوم وقت الاستدلال على مدخل واحد، والثاني هجوم وقت التدريب على رؤية النموذج كلها.

questions.question: How is the effective availability of IDS and IPS deployed in tandem expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعبَّر الإتاحية الفعّالة لـ IDS و IPS المنشورين معاً؟
options: The average of the two individual availabilities.
The product of the two individual availabilities.
The sum of the two individual availabilities.
The minimum of the two individual availabilities.
options_en: The average of the two individual availabilities.
The product of the two individual availabilities.
The sum of the two individual availabilities.
The minimum of the two individual availabilities.
questions.explanation: They are deployed in series, so both must be available and the availabilities multiply.
questions.explanation_ar: يُنشران على التوالي، فلازم الاثنان متاحين والإتاحيتان تتضاربان.

questions.question: Why is the combined availability lower than either component alone?
questions.question_ar: ليش الإتاحية المركّبة أقل من أي مكوّن منفرد؟
options: Because the two components share the same power supply.
Because the product is always smaller than one half.
Because the IPS runs at a lower clock speed.
Because each component adds its own failure probability.
options_ar: لأن المكوّنين يتشاركان نفس مصدر الطاقة.
لأن الحاصل دائماً أصغر من النصف.
لأن الـ IPS يشتغل بسرعة ساعة أقل.
لأن كل مكوّن يضيف احتمال فشله الخاص.
options_en: Because the two components share the same power supply.
Because the product is always smaller than one half.
Because the IPS runs at a lower clock speed.
Because each component adds its own failure probability.
questions.explanation: Two components at ninety-nine percent each give about ninety-eight percent together, because either one failing affects the chain.
questions.explanation_ar: مكوّنان بتسعة وتسعين بالمئة لكل واحد يعطيان حوالي ثمانية وتسعين معاً، لأن فشل أي واحد يؤثّر بالسلسلة.

questions.question: How is the expected loss under IDS/IPS protection expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعبَّر الخسارة المتوقّعة تحت حماية IDS/IPS؟
options: Attack probability times one minus detection times prevention, times impact.
Attack probability times detection times prevention, times impact.
Attack probability plus one minus detection, times impact.
Detection times prevention divided by the attack probability.
options_ar: احتمال الهجوم × (واحد ناقص الكشف × المنع) × التأثير.
الكشف × المنع مقسوماً على احتمال الهجوم.
options_en: Attack probability times one minus detection times prevention, times impact.
Attack probability times detection times prevention, times impact.
Attack probability plus one minus detection, times impact.
Detection times prevention divided by the attack probability.
questions.explanation: Loss only materialises when an attack occurs and the combined detection-and-prevention chain fails to stop it.
questions.explanation_ar: الخسارة تتحقّق بس لمّا يصير هجوم وتفشل سلسلة الكشف والمنع معاً بإيقافه.

questions.question: What does the product of detection and prevention represent?
questions.question_ar: شنو يمثّل حاصل ضرب الكشف بالمنع؟
options: The availability of the sensor during an attack.
The cost of running both systems together.
The effective protection against a successful attack.
The total number of alerts generated per day.
options_en: The availability of the sensor during an attack.
The cost of running both systems together.
The effective protection against a successful attack.
The total number of alerts generated per day.
questions.explanation: Detection alone does nothing if prevention fails, and prevention cannot act on what was never detected, so only the product removes risk.
questions.explanation_ar: الكشف وحده ما يسوي شي لو فشل المنع، والمنع ما يقدر يتصرّف بشي ما انكشف أبداً، فالحاصل وحده يزيل الخطر.
